about: The 19 Locust units and the Hopper token, from docs/ideation-track-2/tribes/locust/units.json (ideation track 2, nothing decided). Terms a card's text uses (Molt, Guard, Hopper, Tide +N, Eat) are explained by display.json entries; 'reminders' holds only lines no display entry gives. 'golden_text' and an effect's 'golden' values give the design's golden line where it is not a plain doubling.

cards.name: Prophet of the Dust
cards.text: At the end of your turn, Tide +{amount}.

cards.name: Horde-runner
cards.text: At the start of your turn, get a Hopper.
cards.golden_text: At the start of your turn, get {count} Hoppers.

cards.name: Wheat Raider
cards.text:
Molt.
When this dies, deal {amount} damage to a random enemy.

cards.name: Brood Mother
cards.text: When this dies, summon a Hopper and give your Hoppers +{bonus}/+{bonus} for the rest of the game.
cards.golden_text: When this dies, summon {count} Hoppers and give your Hoppers +{bonus}/+{bonus} for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Skin-shedder
cards.text: Start of fight: Give Molt to the units next to this.
cards.golden_text: Start of fight: Give Molt twice to the units next to this.
reminders: Each Molt given is one more return this fight, on top of any Molt the unit has.

cards.name: Gleaner
cards.text: After a friendly unit dies, deal {amount} damage to the highest-Health enemy.

cards.name: Gorger
cards.text: The first time you sell a unit each turn, this eats it.
cards.golden_text: The first time you sell a unit each turn, this eats it and gains double its stats.

cards.name: Orchard Stripper
cards.text: When this dies, deal {amount} damage to all enemies.

cards.name: Granary Glutton
cards.text: Whenever you sell a Locust, this eats it.
cards.golden_text: Whenever you sell a Locust, this eats it and gains double its stats.

cards.name: War-drummer
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, trigger the death effect of a unit behind it.
cards.golden_text: Whenever this attacks, trigger the death effect of a unit behind it twice.

cards.name: Twice-shed Veteran
cards.text: After another friendly unit returns, it and this gain +{amount}/+{amount} this fight.

cards.name: The Eighth Plague
cards.text: After a friendly unit dies, deal damage to a random enemy equal to the number of friendly units that died this fight.
cards.golden_text: After a friendly unit dies, deal damage to a random enemy equal to twice the number of friendly units that died this fight.

cards.name: Dirge-singer
cards.golden_text: Your death effects trigger three times.

cards.name: Mother of Thousands
cards.text: Whenever you summon Hoppers, summon twice as many.
cards.golden_text: Whenever you summon Hoppers, summon three times as many.
